cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - DoubleFlexDoorBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with two part lid with living hinges and round corners
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes DoubleFlexDoorBox --x 160 --y 80 --h 70 --radius 20 --latchsize 6 --thickness 4 --burn 0.15 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes DoubleFlexDoorBox --x --y --h --radius --latchsize --thickness --burn --reference --labels
